encode_video_id_with_provider: encode a video ID with provider and optional model ID using base64
decode_video_id_with_provider: decode an encoded video ID to extract provider, model ID, and original video ID
encode_character_id_with_provider: encode a character ID with provider and optional model ID using base64
decode_character_id_with_provider: decode an encoded character ID to extract provider, model ID, and original character ID
extract_original_video_id: extract the original video ID from an encoded video ID string
